text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer <username>, Thank you for your hard 
work. Here is my daily report for today."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 37.7°C (normal), no body 
pain. Meals: Attached records for 3 meals 
(no snacks)."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Voluntary Training Report: 1 hr treadmill 
(Morning), 2 km pool swim (Morning), 2 
uphill runs (Evening)"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That is all. Please review it. —Air 
Messiah"
choice_data_list:
...We exchange daily reports like that 
every day.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh~... I see, I see~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"How do you communicate with your 
trainee?" When asked, I answered... but my 
colleague just tilted her head in 
confusion with a puzzled "hmmm."

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I totally think it's fine, it's super 
clear! I get that it's super important 
information to share, but... uuum.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She's your trainee, right? Couldn't you be 
a little more casual with each other?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You know, sometimes being closer makes it 
way easier to ask for advice and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While having serious exchanges as a 
matter of routine is all well and good... 
it's not ideal if it creates distance or 
makes me seem unapproachable for 
consultations."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Air Messiah is already dependable enough 
on her own. I need to make the effort to 
become someone she feels comfortable 
relying on."
choice_data_list:
Still... breaking, huh? Will it really 
break... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Well! This is just how we did it at my 
place, but—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: I know a great way to do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... on the following Saturday, exactly 
five minutes before the meetup time.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... good morning. Did you just arrive?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Fufu, it almost feels as if right 
now is the meeting time.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's a little early, but shall we get 
going? To scout out the Hanshin 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. My colleague suggested 'a trip for 
the two of us.' ...As an excuse, it was 
quite premature, but I framed it as 
scouting ahead for next year's Oka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, spending that extraordinary 
time together seemed to bring my colleague 
and their Umamusume a lot closer.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"When you go out on a date, you know, you 
both dress up all nice first, right? That 
special feeling is what—"
choice_data_list:
...Even though it's Saturday, you're 
wearing your uniform?

...Even though it's Saturday, you're 
wearing your uniform?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, since you said it was a 
preliminary inspection, I thought formal 
attire would be appropriate...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, was there any inconvenience?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're wearing a suit too, 
Trainer... right?
choice_data_list:
(Yeah, that's right, it just completely 
slipped my mind...)

(Yeah, that's right, it just completely 
slipped my mind...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe using 'scouting the racecourse' 
as an excuse was a bad idea. Both she and 
I ended up wearing surprisingly formal 
clothes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regretting the setup at this point was too 
late――

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"On the bullet train, we can chat away! 
Let's bring a whole bunch of snacks and 
share everything!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Since this will be your pre-race meal, I 
prepared a boxed lunch with that in mind 
for you to eat in the car while we travel.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Would you mind checking this over for me 
to see if the nutrition is well-balanced?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Please, do not 
hesitate to share your candid feedback.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"The main event has gotta be sightseeing! 
Let's hit up all the places we both love 
and get hyped for, spending every single 
minute we've got!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
From Nigawa Station on the Hankyu Imazu 
Line, it's about 5 minutes via the 
underground walkway... As expected, this 
seems to be the standard route.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"However, we must also consider potential 
issues on race day, such as train delays—"
choice_data_list:
Maybe we should consider a bus-focused 
route as well

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, gladly. Let us start over from the 
inn once more.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"‘They're a student, so you have to keep 
that in mind, but staying up just a tiny 
bit later than usual is totally 
recommended! We played games together and 
stuff~’"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"—With this report concluded, this will 
serve as today's daily report email."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And... since we're in the dorms, it's 
almost curfew. Excuse me, I'll head back 
to my room first.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'd like to make a bit more progress 
on preparing for next week's classes... 
Trainer, please feel free to relax and 
take your time.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Well then, good night.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Eh. So the trip was seriously just 
meant for scouting the course like 
that...!?
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry, after you went out of your way 
to suggest it...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, you don't need to apologize at 
all! Whaaat, is thaaat... so...?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, by the way, what are you writing 
there? ...Whoa, that's a really detailed 
report!
choice_data_list:
I thought I'd at least put together what I 
found from scouting...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: I... I se-e-e-e-e...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The main goal was supposed to be "closing 
the distance"... Yet when it comes to 
"scouting the racetrack," I can't help but 
scout it completely seriously.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, since we went together, I 
even ended up putting together a full 
summary report. This wasn't supposed to 
happen, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-san. I look forward to 
working with you today as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me, before we begin... ...There 
is one thing I would like to say to you 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Here's the scouting report on Hanshin 
Racecourse. Thank you very much for 
putting it together so thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I looked over it thoroughly. ...It gave 
me a truly reassuring feeling."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"With this, I'm sure everything will be 
just fine during the actual Oka Sho, no 
matter what happens."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Because together with you, we were able to 
prepare so solidly and steadily like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I was able to reflect upon and 
cherish the feelings I had when we first 
signed our contract.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad that the one who teamed up 
with me was you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Because you treasure the very same 
things I do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tension that had gripped both my 
shoulders... suddenly fades away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eccentric, perhaps. Maybe even a little 
amusing. The relationship between her and 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For us, it's like this. In this form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her smiling face, I felt more 
certain of it than ever before...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for interrupting. Shall we start 
the meeting?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ? Yes, here you go.
choice_data_list:
Mind if I tweak the daily report template 
a bit?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer <username>, Thank you for your hard 
work. Here is my daily report for today."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 37.9°C (normal), no body 
pain. Meals: Attached records for 3 meals 
+ 1 snack."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Voluntary Training Report: 1200m turf x 2 
(Noon), 1600m woodchip x 3 (Evening)"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Remarks:"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"As I ran today, I pictured the Hanshin 
Racecourse in my mind. Thank you for such 
a meaningful Saturday."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That is all. Please review it. —Air 
Messiah"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Air Messiah, Thank you for the daily 
report. Acknowledged."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Remarks:"
choice_data_list: I had a very meaningful time as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I type, 'I look forward to continuing to 
work with you,' and click send. Then, I 
lean back lightly against my chair and 
stretch."
choice_data_list: Alright... let's give it our best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep taking earnest steps forward, 
true to who we are. ...With that thought, 
we renewed our determination.
